data.name: Faatin
data.gender_notes: Faatin is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Faatin means 'one who tests or probes'. This name is derived from the Quranic verse 'And We will put a test on you with various things, and (on every man) We will make you, as a trial, a good example, or We will take you as a witness.' (Al-Anbiya 21:35). The name Faatin carries the meaning “Tests, Discerns, or Probes” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faatin usually hope their child will grow to embody tests, discerns, or probes and live with faith, good character and purpose.
